title: LLMjacking now targets cloud billing accounts, not only API keys
dek: Attackers linked their own projects to compromised victims' billing accounts and ran large volumes of AI inference outside victims' logging scope.
evidence: Wiz incident-response research from multiple investigated cases
takeaway: Monitor billing-account membership and cross-project attachments as first-class AI abuse indicators.

sections.title: Attack chain

bullets.detail: Wiz describes sponsored-search phishing that stole privileged cloud credentials and session factors, followed by weakening organization-policy domain restrictions and granting external accounts billing authority.
External attacker-controlled projects were attached to victim billing accounts, so Gemini API charges accrued to the victim while prompts and model logs remained in foreign projects.

paragraphs: Entry: Wiz describes sponsored-search phishing that stole privileged cloud credentials and session factors, followed by weakening organization-policy domain restrictions and granting external accounts billing authority.
Abuse: External attacker-controlled projects were attached to victim billing accounts, so Gemini API charges accrued to the victim while prompts and model logs remained in foreign projects.

sections.title: Detection and containment

bullets.detail: Wiz reports some victims accrued tens to hundreds of thousands of dollars in unauthorized AI API consumption over 24–48 hours; amounts are case observations, not a typical-case estimate.
Alert on billing.resourceAssociations.create, external billing admins, policy-domain changes, unexpected model enablement and spend anomalies; enforce least privilege on billing relationships.

paragraphs: Observed impact: Wiz reports some victims accrued tens to hundreds of thousands of dollars in unauthorized AI API consumption over 24–48 hours; amounts are case observations, not a typical-case estimate.

Controls: Alert on billing.resourceAssociations.create, external billing admins, policy-domain changes, unexpected model enablement and spend anomalies; enforce least privilege on billing relationships.
